enable_backup_service.description: Enable or disable the Cinder backup service.

database_connection.description: Database connection string (overrides automatic generation using other DB variables).

db_password.description: Password for Cinder database user (used only if database_connection not provided).

db_host.description: Hostname or IP of the database server (used only if database_connection not provided).

db_name.description: Name of the Cinder database (used only if database_connection not provided).

redis_host.description: Hostname or IP of Redis server (optional — used for caching). Leave empty to disable Redis.

backup_swift_url.description: Swift service URL (required if using Swift backup driver).

backup_swift_container.description: Swift container name to store backups.

backup_object_size.description: Size (in bytes) of each backup object chunk. Larger values reduce metadata overhead; smaller values improve parallelism.

backup_max_concurrent_operations.description: Maximum number of concurrent backup/restore operations.

backup_tombstone_age.description: Age (in seconds) after which backup tombstones (soft-deleted backups) are purged. 0 disables automatic purging.

api_bind_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the backup API service to.

api_bind_port.description: Port to listen on for backup API requests.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL for the backup API endpoint.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if ssl_enabled=true).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if ssl_enabled=true).

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for client verification (optional).

rate_limit.description: Maximum requests per second per project. 0 disables rate limiting.

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name for the Cinder service user.

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name for the Cinder service user.

keystone_username.description: Keystone username for the Cinder service user.

keystone_password.description: Keystone password for the Cinder service user.

keystone_ssl_verify.description: Verify Keystone TLS certificates. Disable only in test/dev environments.

lock_path.description: Directory for file-based locking (required for multi-node deployments).

cors_enabled.description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers in API responses.

policy_file.description: Path to the policy definition file.

log_config.description: Log the entire configuration file on service startup for debugging.

enable_versioned_objects.description: Enable versioned objects for API and DB object compatibility across upgrades.
